commands.name: configure
commands.description: View or update CLI settings (api_base, token)

commands.name: goldens delete
commands.description: Delete a golden record (does not remove files on disk)

commands.name: goldens get
commands.description: Show one golden by slug

commands.name: goldens list
commands.description: List all registered goldens

commands.name: goldens regenerate
commands.description: Regenerate a golden's on-disk tree from its pinned template

commands.name: goldens register
commands.description: Register a template-pristine golden scenario

commands.name: goldens update
commands.description: Patch a golden's path and/or template version

commands.name: manifest clear-stale
commands.description: Clear staleness override for a (skill, golden) manifest

commands.name: manifest get
commands.description: Show one manifest by (skill_id, golden_slug)

commands.name: manifest list
commands.description: List all stored manifests

commands.name: manifest upsert
commands.description: Create or replace a manifest

commands.name: record get
commands.description: Show one record by id

commands.name: record list
commands.description: List validation records (paginated)

commands.name: report coverage
commands.description: Per-skill coverage grid for one golden

commands.name: report golden-summary
commands.description: Latest verdict per skill and tool for a golden

commands.name: report skill-fitness
commands.description: Cross-golden trust/cost/convergence aggregate for one skill

commands.name: report tuple-history
commands.description: Paginated record history for one (skill|tool, golden) tuple

commands.name: skill-catalog get
commands.description: Show one mirrored skill by id

commands.name: skill-catalog list
commands.description: List mirrored skills (id, version, content_hash)

commands.name: skill-catalog sync
commands.description: Pull the current skill set from prompt-manager and reconcile the local mirror

commands.name: staleness list
commands.description: List stale (skill, golden) tuples

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check API health

commands.name: validation get
commands.description: Show one validation run by id

commands.name: validation list-active
commands.description: List runs whose status is not terminal

commands.name: validation start
commands.description: Queue a new validation run (returns immediately; use --wait to poll for terminal)
